name: olmene-video
description: Olmene promo videos, made with Remotion (TikTok 9:16)

scripts.render: remotion render OlmeneTikTok out/olmene-tiktok-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --x264-preset=slow --color-space=bt709 --audio-bitrate=320k && node scripts/finalize.mjs out/olmene-tiktok-raw.mp4 renders/olmene-tiktok.mp4
scripts.render:sfx-only: remotion render OlmeneTikTok out/olmene-tiktok-sfx-raw.mp4 --props={\"music\":false} --codec=h264 --crf=17 --x264-preset=slow --color-space=bt709 --audio-bitrate=320k && node scripts/finalize.mjs out/olmene-tiktok-sfx-raw.mp4 renders/olmene-tiktok-sfx-only.mp4
